name: nekromoff/adminer-parquet
description: Read-only Parquet driver/plugin for Adminer 5.x (pure PHP, no native library)

suggest.ext-zstd: Required to read Zstandard-compressed Parquet files (the common default from Spark/Arrow/DuckDB). Install via PECL: 'sudo apt-get install php-dev php-pear && sudo pecl install zstd'. Also add 'extension=zstd.so' to your 'php.ini' file to enable and restart server.
suggest.vrana/adminer: Adminer 5.x, the database management tool this driver plugs into
